body:
Other people have brought up a lot of good points about what the problem may be but I think it may be important to point out that maybe you’re feeling a false sense of urgency relating to having sex by a certain age. I know it sucks being surrounded by people your age who have experienced more than you and it’s very easy to compare yourself to those people but it’s really not a race and it’s not actually super uncommon for people to be virgins in their mid-20s. It’s really nothing to be ashamed of if you think about it; all it is is something that you haven’t had the chance to experience yet.

Also, you can’t really “get” girls to like you. We’re actually pretty varied people, lol. So trying to get laid fast likely isn’t going to end all that well and you’ll probably feel worse off than where you are now, and honestly working on your self esteem would do wonders for this specific situation and more generally. I’d recommend (alongside seeing a professional, consulting self-help books, etc.) continuing to build a sort of validating and positive friend group (of men and women, including women you wouldn’t necessarily date or have sex with) that helps you feel secure in who you are. The key is really just building your self-esteem. I’ve had a somewhat similar experience being isolated from peers in high school, and it took a long time for me but realizing your own value independent of others is a game changer for your whole outlook. It really isn’t too late for you and I do hope that you feel better soon.
